== Summary ==
Player list with victory points from the Welsh Open UK Year Starter in Liverpool, 25 January 2020 (6 players), posted by [[Kevin Jaap]] the next day. [[John Moorley]] and Kevin Jaap lead on 10 victory points.

* '''Event:''' [[John Moorley]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2020-01-26
